__NOTOC__
{{recipesummary
| category = Pizza recipes
| servings = 4–6
| yield = 2 medium pizzas (8 slices each)
| time = 90 minutes
| difficulty = 3
| Image = [[Image:PeperonniPizza.jpg|300px]]
}}{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Italy|Cuisine of Italy]] | [[Cookbook:Pizza|Pizza]]
==Ingredients==

=== Dough ===
* 1 [[Cookbook:cup|cup]] warm [[Cookbook:water|water]] 
* 3 [[Cookbook:tablespoon|tbsp]] active dry [[Cookbook:Yeast|yeast]]
* 1 tbsp white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:pound|lb]] [[Cookbook:flour|all purpose flour]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]

=== Toppings ===
* [[Cookbook:Pepperoni|Pepperoni]]
* 8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] [[Cookbook:Mozzarella Cheese|mozzarella cheese]]
* ½ can (15 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) of Hunt's Family Favorites Pizza sauce
* 1 small [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], finely [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* 1 small [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|red pepper]], finely diced
* 3 ½ [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] sliced [[Cookbook:Mushroom|mushrooms]]
* [[Cookbook:Oregano|Oregano]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Black pepper]]

==Procedure==
# Dissolve yeast and sugar in 1 cup warm water.
# Combine 3 cups of flour, olive oil, one [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] of salt, and the yeast-water mixture. [[Cookbook:Kneading|Knead]] for 15 minutes, adding more flour until dough is no longer very sticky.
# Coat dough with a little oil (about 1 tsp) and place it into a large bowl. Cover with [[Cookbook:Plastic Wrap|plastic wrap]] and let rest for 45 minutes until the dough is twice its original size.
# Meanwhile, preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 350°F / 175°C for at least 30 minutes).
# Gently deflate dough in order to eliminate air bubbles.
# Cut dough into 2 pieces (you can freeze dough to bake later for up to a month).
# [[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|Roll out]] dough to form a rounded pizza crust.
# Add pizza sauce (½ can per pizza), and sprinkle onion, red pepper, salt, oregano and black pepper.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] 10 minutes.
# Take out of the oven, add mozzarella cheese, pepperoni, and mushrooms.
# Return to the oven and bake until cheese melts.
# Cut into eight slices, and enjoy!

==Notes, tips, and variations==
* Water must be warm but not boiling in order to activate yeast. Boiling water will kill the yeast.
* You can replace ¼ of water cup with [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]. You can also replace the sugar with 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]].
* If you like a stronger cheese flavor, you can add, for example, little chunks of bleu cheese, on top of the other ingredients.
* Try to keep the mushrooms fairly dry. Mushrooms are like sponges, and will lose unwanted water on to your pizza.
* You can try different toppings to basic pizza dough, and even add cheese borders. To do so, you should roll out pizza into a larger size, adding cheese one [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] from the border, and little pizza sauce. Roll dough over the cheese and press firmly to close.
